text: SOURCE LOCALIZATION in /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/rust/mote: src/candidate.rs:143-148 GitCandidateRelation stores only candidate-to-tip relation; probe_ancestry at :362-373 computes ancestor_relation(other.commit_oid, commit_oid) but never other.commit_oid versus base_oid. src/state.rs:783-798 sends every tip ancestor to check_ancestor_candidate; :968-972 unconditionally emits ancestor_abandoned for abandoned phase. Minimal schema-compatible direction is to add a base-relative relation per known candidate, compute it in probe_ancestry and the unavailable fallback, require it to be conclusive, and call check_ancestor_candidate only when tip=Ancestor and base=NotAncestor. Existing serialized receipts need serde default plus refresh-before-landability, or a versioned receipt; do not default missing base relation to NotAncestor. Relevant protocol tests begin tests/candidate_protocol.rs:326. No source edits made.
